BFS gives you the open data of the
[Swiss Federal Statistical Office](https://www.bfs.admin.ch/bfs/en/home/statistics/catalogue.html)
(BFS, *Bundesamt für Statistik*) in R, as tidy data frames, in German,
French, Italian or English.

This page shows which API to use for which data, where the BFS is moving its
data, and a first download from each API.

## Which API for which data

The BFS publishes its data through four APIs. BFS has functions for each:

| You want | Use | API |
|---|---|---|
| Statistics of the Swiss Stats Explorer | `bfs_get_sse_metadata()`, `bfs_get_sse_data()` | [Swiss Stats Explorer](https://stats.swiss/) (SDMX) |
| Datasets of the BFS data catalog | `bfs_get_catalog_data()`, `bfs_get_metadata()`, `bfs_get_data()` | [STAT-TAB](https://www.pxweb.bfs.admin.ch/pxweb/en/) (PXWeb) |
| Tables and files (Excel, CSV, PX, ...) | `bfs_get_catalog_tables()`, `bfs_download_asset()` | DAM |
| Maps and geodata | `bfs_get_base_maps()`, `bfs_get_catalog_geodata()`, `bfs_download_geodata()` | ThemaKart, STAC |

- The **Swiss Stats Explorer** (SSE) is the new data platform of the BFS. Its
  datasets have an id such as `DF_LWZ_1`.
- **STAT-TAB** is the older platform. Its datasets (data cubes) have a BFS
  number such as `px-x-1502040100_131`.
- The **DAM** API serves every file published by the BFS, e.g. the Excel
  tables of the website.
- The **geodata** come from the Swiss geo-portal and from the cartographic
  base maps of the BFS.

## From STAT-TAB to the Swiss Stats Explorer

The BFS is replacing STAT-TAB with the Swiss Stats Explorer: it moves most
of its data cubes to the new platform, one statistic at a time, and will then
switch off STAT-TAB. See the
[BFS announcement](https://www.bfs.admin.ch/bfs/en/home/services/research/stat-tab-online-data-search.html)
for the current timeline.

For your code, this means:

- `bfs_get_data()`, `bfs_get_metadata()` and `bfs_get_data_comments()` use the
  STAT-TAB API. They will stop working when STAT-TAB is switched off.
- During the migration, a statistic can be on STAT-TAB only, on both
  platforms, or on the Swiss Stats Explorer only.
- If a BFS number no longer works, look for the statistic by name on
  [stats.swiss](https://stats.swiss/).
- The tables and files (DAM) and the geodata functions are not affected.

::: {.callout .callout-tip}
For new code, use the Swiss Stats Explorer when the statistic is there, and
STAT-TAB only for the data not yet migrated.
:::

## A first download

```{r}
library(BFS)
```

### Swiss Stats Explorer

The dataset id (here `DF_LWZ_1`, the vacant dwellings) is in the URL of the
dataset on [stats.swiss](https://stats.swiss/). Get its codelists, the codes
of the values of each dimension:

```{r}
codelist <- bfs_get_sse_metadata("DF_LWZ_1", language = "en")
codelist
```

Then download the data you need, with a query of codes for each dimension:

```{r}
bfs_get_sse_data(
  number_bfs = "DF_LWZ_1",
  language = "en",
  query = list(
    GR_KT_GDE = c("4001", "2581"), # Aarau and Olten
    WOHN_ANZAHL = "_T",            # all numbers of rooms
    LEERWOHN_TYP = "4",            # vacant dwellings for rent
    MEASURE_DIMENSION = "OBS"      # number of dwellings (not the rate)
  ),
  start_period = "2020",
  end_period = "2023"
)
```

[Swiss Stats Explorer](https://felixluginbuhl.com/BFS/articles/swiss-stats-explorer.html) shows how to build
the query from the labels of the codelist.

### STAT-TAB

Search the BFS data catalog, then download a dataset with its BFS number:

```{r}
bfs_get_catalog_data(language = "en", extended_search = "university students")

bfs_get_data(number_bfs = "px-x-1502040100_131", language = "en")
```

[Data catalog and PXWeb datasets](https://felixluginbuhl.com/BFS/articles/pxweb.html) shows how to search
the catalog and download only part of a dataset.

## Next steps

- [Swiss Stats Explorer](https://felixluginbuhl.com/BFS/articles/swiss-stats-explorer.html): build a query
  from the codelists.
- [Data catalog and PXWeb datasets](https://felixluginbuhl.com/BFS/articles/pxweb.html): search the catalog
  and download all or part of a dataset.
- [Tables and files](https://felixluginbuhl.com/BFS/articles/tables-and-files.html): download any BFS file.
- [Geodata and base maps](https://felixluginbuhl.com/BFS/articles/geodata.html): maps of Switzerland and
  geodata of the Swiss geo-portal.
- [API errors and rate limits](https://felixluginbuhl.com/BFS/articles/troubleshooting.html): what to do
  when an API is not available.
